_note: First-touch texts (no AI involved, so they're predictable). Placeholders: {first} {who} {property} {platform} (becomes ' on Crexi', ' on LoopNet', or nothing). Keep 'Reply STOP to opt out.' email_first_touch is used when the lead has no phone (no STOP line; Outlook adds the signature).
listing_email: Hi{first}, this is {who}. Saw your inquiry on {property}{platform}. Are you buying for yourself or with a group? Reply STOP to opt out.
csv: Hi{first}, this is {who}. Following up on your interest in {property}. Are you still looking at parks right now? Reply STOP to opt out.
webhook: Hi{first}, this is {who}. Saw your inquiry on {property}{platform}. Are you buying for yourself or with a group? Reply STOP to opt out.
default: Hi{first}, this is {who}. Thanks for your interest in {property}. Are you buying for yourself or with a group? Reply STOP to opt out.
email_first_touch:
Hi{first},

Saw your inquiry on {property}{platform}. Happy to send over the details. Quick question so I point you to the right materials: are you buying for yourself or with a group, and do you own parks today?
